body: orbitalwidgets adds a compact workspace switcher and keyboard-driven launcher to the desktop. open its settings to choose the bar position, configure shortcuts, and select which workspaces appear. all settings stay on this computer. this fictional plugin is used only for offline search-pack integration tests.
